question: What made this a good time to come in?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “It’s happened several evenings this week—what sounds like a familiar voice calling my name from the hallway. On Monday I opened the front door to see if it was a neighbor, but nobody was there. I feel a bit silly about that. I’ve kept taking my tablet, so I wanted to talk about the change.”
